metadata.technology_specification: Touchscreen smartphone with OLED display and lithium-ion battery
metadata.technology_reasoning: Modern smartphones with OLED displays represent over 60% of premium and mid-range devices as of 2024, having become the industry standard due to superior contrast, power efficiency, and thin form factors.

Display Module (OLED).name: Glass
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Serves as substrate providing structural support and transparency, universally used in display modules.

Display Module (OLED).name: Indium
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Key component of indium tin oxide transparent conductor layer, industry standard for touch and display functionality.

Display Module (OLED).name: Aluminum
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Used as cathode electrode and reflective layers in OLED displays due to good conductivity and reflectivity.

Display Module (OLED).name: Silver
Display Module (OLED).reasoning: Common conductors in OLEDs, can be substituted, thus moderate confidence.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Lithium
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Primary electrochemical element in lithium-ion batteries essential for energy storage.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Cobalt
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Common cathode material used to improve energy density and stability, albeit alternatives exist.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Nickel
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Used in cathodes to enhance capacity and cycle life; standard material though ratios vary.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Copper
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Current collector and electrical conductor inside the battery, universally required.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Aluminum
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Cathode current collector and casing material widely used in battery designs.

Battery Pack (Li-ion).name: Graphite
Battery Pack (Li-ion).reasoning: Primary anode material allowing lithium intercalation; universally implemented.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Copper
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Essential for electrical circuitry and traces on PCB; standard with no substitutes.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Epoxy resins
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Key polymer for PCB substrate and laminates providing mechanical stability and electrical insulation.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Fiberglass
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Reinforces PCB substrate, common industrial base material for structural support.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Tin
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Used for solder and surface plating on copper pads to enable component assembly; widely used standard.

Main Circuit Board (PCB).name: Lead
Main Circuit Board (PCB).reasoning: Traditional solder element, but increasingly substituted due to RoHS regulations, moderate confidence.

Camera Module.name: Glass
Camera Module.reasoning: Lens and protective cover material providing optical clarity and durability.

Camera Module.name: Silicon
Camera Module.reasoning: Semiconductor material for image sensors, universally foundational.

Camera Module.name: Copper
Camera Module.reasoning: Electrical interconnects and wiring within the module.

Camera Module.name: Aluminum
Camera Module.reasoning: Housing and structural components, light and durable metal.

Chassis/Frame.name: Aluminum
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Widely used lightweight metal for smartphone chassis and frames due to strength and corrosion resistance.

Chassis/Frame.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Used in steel chassis or frames providing high strength and rigidity.

Chassis/Frame.name: Glass
Chassis/Frame.reasoning: Some chassis incorporate glass panels; moderately confident due to varied designs.

Speakers.name: Copper
Speakers.reasoning: Wire coils and electrical connections require copper for conductivity.

Speakers.name: Neodymium
Speakers.reasoning: Rare earth magnets commonly used in speaker magnets to provide strong magnetic fields.

Speakers.name: Aluminum
Speakers.reasoning: Used in casing and diaphragm materials due to light weight and strength, alternatives exist.

Vibration Motor.name: Copper
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Coils in the motor require copper for electrical conduction; universally used.

Vibration Motor.name: Steel Ingots
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Motor shaft and housing often made from steel, providing strength and durability.

Vibration Motor.name: Neodymium
Vibration Motor.reasoning: Magnets used in vibration motors for creating magnetic fields; standard but some designs vary.
